pages.text: $(li)Build your first bonsai setup only after Chapter 4–5, when usability improvements unlock; earlier attempts will be frustratingly slow.

$(li)Do not attempt final bonsai crafting before Chapter 9—it requires unlocked recipes and materials only available then.$(li)MK-12 bonsais appear only in the Proxima Belt, and only after reaching Chapter 6 or 7; plan your travel accordingly.
